VASSAL.build.module.folder.ModuleSubFold.name: Mark Benson Change Log

VASSAL.build.module.folder.ModuleSubFold.desc: Cards 60-61 names corrected for card strengths.
Mouseover player aid (board popups) option. Works in campaign scenario. Environment table and others missing or misaligned in other scenarios.
Trade Command prototype created to rationalise faction trade actions and provide face-down play. Includes update to Event Cards and faction Events p/types.
Face down event & handicap card shows non-masked (inset) to owner.
Remove non-functional help assets and add two new ones.
(Some) Commands are suppressed when not relevant in or out of hand window. Battle/Bid key command changed to Ctrl+B (Alt+Ctrl+Shift+Q could not be suppressed).
Adapt card play controls to 2,3 and solo (standard) game modes. No trade restrictions on Solo in open or CDGSM hands.
Add PlayerSide to PlayerId (Global Options). Mainly for chat log.
Consolidate event card traits into the Event Cards p/type & Nationality marker into faction event card p/types.
Suppress advance/return commands, including for leaders & Kutusov
Correct target return zone on French preempt debate marker.
Standardise "Return" & Negotiation Table Key Commands. Replace all Alt+Z with a non-user key command.
Simpllify and automate issue marker rotation.
[WIP] mapMove / card counter redundant trait removal, count in all hands (test feature?) & make counters more visible.
Minimum JVM max heap set to 1024.
Shapes - Army block issue & missing Russian Generalissimo
Hand window names/tooltip improvements.
Fix Kutusov card back, adding Mask trait. Make help text show only when card is unmasked.
Match cell size to stacked card space in player hand grids.
Russian Generalissimo now has own piece. Placement is mutally exclusive with Austrain Gen.
Player Hand layout & management. Fix for Kutusov in hand count.
Army block movement. Removed clone command.
Mask configuration reverted (rest of configuration doesn't allow use of other options)
Wager feature separated out from Battle, controlled by Yellow/Gold pawn.
Leader cards relocated from hand to main board.
Improve player hand card management.
Card / Counters layers rationalised.
Movement reporting suppressed unless location changes (all maps)
Fix battling (facedown) issues. Split Bid from Battle & rationalise battle actions (limit to specific hands?)

VASSAL.build.module.SpecialDieFace.text: C: Flip top card C. Active Power may save a face up PUMC (no trasferred PUMC deck). Play card Cor the lowest lettered card A,B,C or D for this Power (player´s choice if tie)
AB: Flip face up any face-down cards in spaces A and B. Active Power may save one face up PUMC (if PUMC deck is not transferred). Play card A or B
DE: Flip face up any face down cards in spaces D and E. Active Power may save one face up PUMC (if PUMC deck is not transferred). Play card D or E.
ABC: Flip face up any face down card in spaces A, B and the top card in C. Active Power may save a one face up PUMC card (if PUMC is not transferred). Play card A, B or C.
CDE: Flip face up any face down cards in spaces D, E and the top card in C. Active Power may save one face up PUMC (if PUMC is not transferred). Play card C, D or E.
ABDE: Flip face up any face down cards in spaces A, B, D and E. Active Power may save one face up PUMC (if PUMC deck is not transferred). Play card A, B, D or E
C: Flip top card C. French Bot may save a face up PUMC (no trasferred PUMC deck). Play card Cor the lowest French lettered card A,B,C or D (player´s choice if tie)
AB: Flip face up any face-down cards in spaces A and B. French Bot may save one face up PUMC (if PUMC deck is not transferred). Play card A or B
DE: Flip face up any face down cards in spaces D and E. French Bot may save one face up PUMC (if PUMC deck is not transferred). Play card D or E.
ABC: Flip face up any face down card in spaces A, B and the top card in C. French Bot may save a one face up PUMC card (if PUMC is not transferred). Play card A, B or C.
CDE: Flip face up any face down cards in spaces D, E and the top card in C. French Bot may save one face up PUMC (if PUMC is not transferred). Play card C, D or E.
ABDE: Flip face up any face down cards in spaces A, B, D and E. French Bot may save one face up PUMC (if PUMC deck is not transferred). Play card A, B, D or E
